description: Call this when a user asks what ARC recorded for a store, or you need the citable store page. Returns the store page's verdict, checked_at, category, the recorded fix and links to the page, its JSON and Markdown. Example: store_record({"store":"allbirds.com"}) → {"verdict":"…","page_url":"https://www.arcreport.ai/stores/allbirds.com",…}. Reads the published snapshot behind /stores/<host>. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as allbirds.com.

name: store_record
title: Store record
